name: Multiline Internet
summary: Perth dialup/broadband ISP (1990 Multiline BBS Pty Ltd), evolved from Graeme & Gloria Platt's Multiline BBS (TBBS, online since 1984); one of Perth's first ISPs; voluntarily deregistered ~Oct 2016 (ACN 069 815 210).

events.details: Multiline BBS online since 1984; ISP operation (one of Perth's first).
Ceased operating. ABN cancelled; a 'Multiline'-branded website outlived the entity.

refs.label: Official ABN cancellation for the Multiline operator (ABN 78 069 815 210), narrowing the brief's '~Oct 2016' to 29 Jun 2016.
The domain kept serving a Multiline-branded WordPress site after the 2016 deregistration, so the brand outlived the company.
ABR: 1990 MULTILINE BBS PTY LTD ACN 069 815 210
